args.body: For CATALOGUE-BUYER-EXAMPLE-PLACEMENT, use the candidate-preserving-preview receipt and diff if committed and still current. Check the pre-existing draft changes against their authorization and check that the example appears only once in the intended EN/FR placement. Reuse an equivalent completed release candidate. Under your valid lease, stage the verified candidate, confirm the full file inventory and obtain a host dry-run digest. Hand the exact digest and evidence to an eligible independent reviewer. If reconciliation fails, identify the exact conflicting change in the mission evidence. Read back the result before closing with a lesson. Keep CAD 60 provisional and preserve the host publication gate.

description: The fictional catalogue example passed its offline checks and preserved the served inquiry links. The current release draft contains 12 lines of differences from that served baseline, so the next step is to stage a preview that preserves those edits and gives the release owner an exact diff to reconcile. Public deployment still requires independent approval of the exact release digest. Five sources remain unclassified, so demand is unknown. Treasury has CAD 0 available and no verified revenue.
